headline: LinkedIn spent $5,249 over 14 days with zero conversions and is paused; Meta CPA is up 2.2x so it is trimmed 25%; the direct surge tracks AI-assistant referrals, not paid.

moves.reason: Zero conversions for 14 days (since 10/18) on $5,249 spend, with daily spend climbing from ~$300 to ~$423 (rising even above the $450 budget trend). Last-3-week CPA is $412 vs $168 earlier. Likely tracking break or delivery fault; either way the spend is waste. Cheap to reverse once tracking is verified.

CPA up 2.2x over the last 3 weeks ($64.54 to $143.82) on flat spend (~$3.4k/wk). Last-click ROAS 1.17-1.35 for 3 weeks, below the 1.5 target. Self-reported Instagram/Facebook share fell from 18% to 6%, which corroborates a real decline. Attribution models still show ROAS 2.55-4.09 (above target), so trim 25% rather than cut, and test.

tests.hypothesis: Meta's decline since ~9/28 is real lost efficiency, not just a last-click measurement artifact. If it is real, holding out Meta will cost few total conversions.
tests.design: Geo split holdout: pause Meta in ~20% of matched regions for 3-4 weeks while the rest runs at the trimmed $375/day. Measure total conversions (all channels, including direct) and revenue per region, and compare against the holdout. Also audit Meta pixel/CAPI and creative fatigue around 9/28 before reading results.

flag_verdicts.reason: 14 days, $5,249, 0 conversions, daily spend rising from ~$300 to ~$423. Paused. Check the tracking tag before re-enabling.
Meta CPA went from $64.54 to $143.82 (2.2x) over 3 weeks on flat spend. Self-reported Instagram/Facebook share fell from 18% to 6%. Trimmed 25% and a geo holdout test is recommended.
The 9/12-9/18 spend spike (peak week $6,490) held CPA at $22 vs $20-21. Efficiency has since improved to $16-18. No action.

Direct rose from 1.8 to 7.6/day (4.2x) on paid spend at 1.03x. Self-reported AI answers (AI assistant plus ChatGPT) went from 7% to 23%, so an untracked AI-referral source is the likely cause. Don't credit paid channels or move budget on it.

flags.message: linkedin spent $5,249 over 14 days with zero conversions, and spend is still rising.
meta CPA rose 2.4x, from $63 to $148, starting 2026-10-09.
google_search spend jumped for 7 days (2026-09-12 to 2026-09-18); CPA held at $24 vs $19. Likely fine, confirm before acting.
Direct conversions grew 4.2x (1.8 to 7.6/day) while paid spend moved 1.03x. Self-reported AI answers went from 7% to 23%. Something untracked is driving buyers.
